title: IFF

estimate.basis: IFF is optional: there is no late fee. Invoices not furnished in IFF go in the quarter's GSTR-1.

missing: GST_API_PUBLIC_KEY (GSTN’s public key, from your GSP)
gsp.label: GST system through your GSP

offlineSteps: Download the IFF file here: Export → Portal JSON.
On gst.gov.in open Returns Dashboard, pick the month, then IFF → Prepare Offline → Upload, and upload the file.
When it shows Processed, open IFF → Prepare Online, check the summary and file with DSC or EVC.
Mark it as filed here with the date and the ARN.
